evidence.quote: Roma Mitchell was born in Adelaide , South Australia , on 2 October 1913
Mitchell was admitted as a barrister in 1935
In 1962 she was appointed a Queens Counsel

events.text: Made a Justice of the Supreme Court of South Australia.
